name: Web Demo 3 · Human approval of AI-drafted replies

parameters.content:
## Lane 4 · Decide and deliver

Splits approved, edited and rejected; sends the **final** text, records the decision and posts the confirmation.

parameters.query: UPDATE aprovacoes_pendentes SET status = CASE $2::text WHEN 'approved' THEN 'aprovado' WHEN 'adjusted' THEN 'ajustado' WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'recusado' END, texto_final = CASE $2::text WHEN 'approved' THEN rascunho_ia WHEN 'adjusted' THEN $3::text END, motivo_recusa = CASE $2::text WHEN 'rejected' THEN $4::text END, decidido_por = $5::text, decidido_em = now(), houve_correcao = ($2::text = 'adjusted') WHERE id = $1::bigint AND status = 'pendente' RETURNING id, status, houve_correcao, decidido_por;

parameters.content:
## Approve AI-drafted customer replies with human-in-the-loop review

### How it works
A customer message arrives on a webhook. A free model classifies it (topic, urgency), a second model drafts the reply, and the draft is stored as a pending item together with its unique resume URL. The run then **freezes** on a Wait node. Nothing is sent. A reviewer opens the app, reads the customer message next to the AI draft, and clicks Approve, Edit or Reject. That click resumes the very same execution from where it stopped. Approved and edited replies are e-mailed to the customer with the **final** text and a Telegram confirmation is posted; rejected ones are archived with the reason and nothing is sent. The decision records who decided and whether the AI text was corrected. A second trigger on the same canvas watches for items left pending past their deadline.

### Setup steps
1. Create the pending-items table in Postgres (DDL ships with the demo).
2. Add credentials: Groq (classification), OpenAI (drafting), Postgres, Gmail (reply), Telegram (alerts), and a Header Auth credential for the Wait node, shared with your app's backend.
3. Point your app's backend at the webhook path and let it call the stored resume URL - never expose that URL to the browser.
4. Keep the workflow inactive until one clean end-to-end run.

## Lane 1 · Intake

Receives the customer message and answers the app in the same request with the item reference.

## Lane 2 · Intelligence

The free model reads the customer message and returns subject, urgency and whether a person is needed. The paid model then drafts the reply. Each model output passes through a Code node that fails closed, so nothing unreadable reaches the approval screen.

## Lane 3 · Store and hold

Saves the pending item **together with its resume URL**, then freezes. Order matters: past the Wait node that URL can no longer be read.

## Lane 5 · Pending watchdog — its own trigger, started by the clock

It connects to no node of the lane above; it only talks to the table. Every N minutes it asks whether any item sat past its deadline and alerts. It is also the detector for a frozen run that was lost — which is why it must be alive, and not inside the execution that froze.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-oss-20b', temperature: 0, max_completion_tokens: 800, reasoning_effort: 'low', include_reasoning: false, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a customer-service triage assistant. Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else - no prose, no code fences. Schema: {"subject": one of "warranty"|"exchange"|"delivery"|"billing"|"product_info"|"complaint"|"other", "urgency": one of "low"|"medium"|"high", "needs_human": boolean, "summary": one short sentence in the same language as the customer message}. Never invent facts that are not in the message. If something is unclear, choose "other" and set needs_human to true.' }, { role: 'user', content: $('Receive customer message').item.json.body.mensagem } ] }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO aprovacoes_pendentes (origem, remetente_nome, remetente_email, mensagem_cliente, recebido_em, assunto, urgencia, rascunho_ia, resume_url, resumo) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::timestamptz, $6, CASE $7 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 END, $8, $9, $10) RETURNING id, resume_url, status;

parameters.query:
SELECT count(*)::int AS total,
       COALESCE(string_agg(
         format('#%s %s (%s) - %s min',
           id,
           replace(replace(replace(remetente_nome, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
           replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(assunto, 'no subject'), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
           round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - criado_em))/60)),
         E'\n' ORDER BY urgencia DESC, criado_em ASC
       ), '') AS lista
FROM aprovacoes_pendentes
WHERE status = 'pendente'
  AND now() > COALESCE(prazo_aviso, criado_em + interval '15 minutes');

-- Pushes the next warning one hour ahead for everything just alerted,
-- so the same item is not reported again on every 15-minute tick.
UPDATE aprovacoes_pendentes
SET prazo_aviso = now() + interval '60 minutes'
WHERE status = 'pendente'
  AND now() > COALESCE(prazo_aviso, criado_em + interval '15 minutes')
RETURNING id, prazo_aviso;

SELECT id, remetente_nome, remetente_email, texto_final, status, decidido_por, houve_correcao FROM aprovacoes_pendentes WHERE id = $1::bigint AND status IN ('aprovado','ajustado') AND texto_final IS NOT NULL;
